summary: Công cụ lệnh duy nhất để tìm và lọc hàng trăm model LLM tương thích với phần cứng của bạn, hỗ trợ GGUF, MLX, localai và nhiều provider khác.
usecases: Quickly verify if a specific LLM model will run on your GPU/CPU before downloading or deploying
Compare hardware requirements and performance across different model providers and versions
Streamline model selection for local AI development and research projects
ideas: Build a hardware-benchmark integration that auto-recommends optimal models based on detected specs
Create a dashboard tracking model compatibility trends across hardware generations and software stacks
Develop an IDE plugin that checks model feasibility without leaving the editor environment
